title: Uncontrolled recursion in KnowledgeBaseWebReader.get_article_urls due to missing depth increment in recursive calls
trigger_payload:
def get_article_urls(
    self, browser: Any, root_url: str, current_url: str, max_depth: int = 100
) -> List[str]:
    page = browser.new_page(ignore_https_errors=True)
    page.set_default_timeout(60000)
    page.goto(current_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
    if self.article_path in current_url:
        print("Found an article: ", current_url)
        page.close()
        return [current_url]
    article_urls = []
    links = []
    for link_selector in self.link_selectors:
        ahrefs = page.query_selector_all(link_selector)
        links.extend(ahrefs)
    for link in links:
        url = root_url + page.evaluate("(node) => node.getAttribute('href')", link)
        article_urls.extend(
            self.get_article_urls(browser, root_url, url, max_depth)
        )
    page.close()
    return article_urls
oracle: Python process crashes due to exceeding recursion limit
